title: Course simulator dialect (LatheLab / MillLab) - extracted from the simulator's public source
class: SIMULATOR_SETTING (facts about the teaching simulator, not human-approved process data)

source.method: HTML downloaded with curl; supported-code sets, reference entries, defaults and Program-check messages read from the bundled JavaScript. The simulator may change after this date: re-check the hashes before relying on this file. This is a static reading of the source, NOT a simulation run.
source.not_committed: The simulator HTML itself (third-party, ~1.2 MB each) is not stored in the repository.

conventions.X: Absolute position in X - always a DIAMETER on a lathe. X0 is the spindle centre line. (simulator reference)
conventions.Z: Absolute axial position. Z0 is normally the finished front face; negative Z is towards the chuck. (simulator reference)
conventions.U_W: Incremental X (diameter change) / incremental Z. Absolute vs incremental is chosen by the ADDRESS (X/Z vs U/W), not by G90/G91.
conventions.G90: OD/ID turning box cycle (NOT absolute mode). G91 is NOT supported.
conventions.G94_G98_G99: G94 = facing box cycle. G98/G99 = feed per minute / per revolution.
conventions.T: Tool call TttOO, e.g. T0101 = tool 01 with offset 01 (nose radius R and tip T from the offset page)
conventions.G96_G50: G96 constant surface speed should be limited with G50 S.. (warning otherwise)
conventions.threading: G76 multiple threading cycle, G92 single pass, G32 single move; use G97 for threading
conventions.tool_post: slant-bed lathe, turret behind the centre line (rear tool post); G02/G03 as in the usual lathe picture (+X up, +Z right)

conventions.axes: X table left/right, Y towards/away, Z spindle up/down; negative Z goes into the part (simulator lesson 1)
conventions.G54: Work zero set automatically to the chosen top corner or centre of the block (default origin 'corner' = front-left); Z0 on the finished top (default) or raw top
conventions.G43_H: Tool length compensation; without G43 Hnn (or AUTO TOOL COMP) the tip runs one tool length lower - warning
conventions.G41_G42_D: Cutter radius compensation, only simulated in G17; G41/G42 without D -> tool centre on the contour (warning)
conventions.canned_cycles: G73, G74, G76, G81-G86, G89 with G98/G99 return; G80 cancel
conventions.M06: Tool change; cancel G40 / G80 before M06
